why: Image 1 reads more like a real night shoot: the long-exposure blur of a seated guest, the dark armchair as a foreground frame and the low warm light falling off into the room make it look like a place in use, even though the ghost figure is a little too translucent. Image 2 is emptier and more obviously CG, with a flat pinkish block and blown white lamp discs filling the lower-left foreground, a featureless floor plane and a composition that just looks at the alcove rather than placing the reader in the room.
